# archestra_environment (Data Source)

Finds an environment by its exact name. Use `id` wherever an `environment_id` is expected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An environment created outside this configuration, found by name.
data "archestra_environment" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}

output "production_environment_id" {
  value = data.archestra_environment.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact name of the environment.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the environment.
- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace of the environment, when it has its own.
